_comment: Live capture of the Gemini image API surface, 2026-08-09. Every value here was read FROM THE SERVICE, not from documentation. Re-verify with tests/fixtures/gemini/README.md before any run that spends real money.

imagen_4_status.note: The adna_lab precedent client targets this family via client.models.generate_images. It had 8 days left when this backend was written, which is why comic_render targets the Gemini native image models via generate_content instead.

call_path.response: candidates[].content.parts[].inline_data.data (bytes); modalities may be interleaved, so every part must be walked

aspect_ratio_discovery.method: send a deliberately invalid ratio; the 400 enumerates the valid set
aspect_ratio_discovery.cost: none — rejected at validation, before generation

billing_state_at_capture.observed_error: 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Your prepayment credits are depleted.
billing_state_at_capture.scope: account-wide — reproduced on gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image, and a text-only gemini-2.5-flash call
billing_state_at_capture.note: The credential itself is VALID: the invalid-aspect probe returned a well-formed 400, which only happens after successful auth. This is a billing state, not an auth failure and not a rate limit.
